next_modeling_direction.data: Expose period start/end,duration,filing vintage,units and actual exchange sessions as shared input data. Keep concept selection/financial interpretation with the analyst. Preserve complete source frames.
next_modeling_direction.method: Compare the chosen final method with a chronological baseline; validation of a rejected model does not validate its replacement. Hold out new issuers/origins for qualitative evaluation.
next_modeling_direction.numbers: Publish calculated forecast metrics and reference selected numerical artifacts in final answers. Judgmental changes should be explicit executed scenarios with assumptions.
next_modeling_direction.instructions: Keep instructions concise and retain the larger model. Address shared failure mechanisms; no ticker rules or original-forecast patches.
next_modeling_direction.acceptance: Personally review complete new outputs and meaningful cases. Software checks alone do not establish forecasting quality.
